headline: Polaroid’s tiny instant camera is $72 and includes a free pack of film
summary: The second-generation Polaroid Go instant camera is on sale for $71.99. This deal includes a free 16-photo film pack. It's the lowest price seen for this nostalgic camera bundle.

headline: Matt Groening lets slip that Simpsons: Hit & Run might be making a comeback
summary: Simpsons creator Matt Groening hinted at a return for "The Simpsons: Hit & Run" game. He suggested the original game could be coming back "in some form." The comments sparked speculation among fans at D23.

headline: Have a laugh at AI’s expense by roleplaying as a chatbot
summary: "Your AI Slop Bores Me" is a website designed for human-on-human AI roleplay. Users request and answer prompts, mimicking AI chatbot interactions. It offers a humorous way to satirize typical AI output.

headline: Don't overlook Elektron's budget electronic music instruments
summary: Elektron's budget Model:Samples and Model:Cycles are recommended for electronic music beginners. These grooveboxes offer excellent value despite less mainstream attention. They provide an accessible entry point into music production.

headline: Disney Experiences Showcase at D23 2026: Everything Announced for Disney Parks, Disney Cruise Line, and More (Updating Live!)
summary: D23's Disney Experiences Showcase is happening live in Anaheim. Announcements are expected for Disney Parks, Cruise Line, and more. This event covers major news for Disney's global experiences.

headline: 'I Want to Set the Record Straight: That Is Not Happening' — Kingdom Hearts 4 Devs Say KH4 '100%' Will Not Be Delayed Past Late 2027 Launch | D23 2026
summary: Kingdom Hearts 4 developers confirmed the game will not be delayed. They assured a "100%" launch by late 2027. The announcement aimed to set the record straight for anxious fans at D23.

headline: Kingdom Hearts 4 Gets Extended Gameplay Trailer Featuring Playable Mickey, Donald, and Goofy | D23 2026
summary: An extended gameplay trailer for Kingdom Hearts 4 was revealed at D23. The trailer features a first look at playable King Mickey, Donald, and Goofy. Disney and Square Enix showcased the new footage during a panel.

headline: Star Wars: Smuggler's Gambit Lets You Keep Helping Hondo Ohnaka in Fortnite After You Leave Disneyland
summary: "Smuggler's Gambit" is a new Fortnite experience connected to Disneyland's Smuggler's Run. It allows players to continue the Hondo Ohnaka adventure in a PvE multiplayer game. Linking Epic and MyDisney accounts unlocks a special in-park experience.

headline: People who fled Stourbridge fires start to return home
summary: Residents displaced by Stourbridge fires are beginning to return home. Many are just now assessing the full extent of damage to their properties. The community faces the aftermath of the recent blazes.

headline: Reform proposes £50bn welfare bill cut with changes to disability payments for millions
summary: The Reform party proposes a £50 billion cut to the welfare bill. This includes significant changes to disability payments like PIP. Millions of people could be affected by the proposed reforms.

headline: Thousands displaced by deadly Indonesia earthquake as rescue efforts continue
summary: A deadly earthquake in Indonesia has displaced thousands of people. At least 51 people have been killed, with rescue efforts ongoing. Hundreds of homes and public buildings suffered severe damage.

headline: Ariana Grande leaves problems at home as her tour hits the UK
summary: Ariana Grande's tour has arrived in the UK for 10 dates in London. The star plans to "step back" from public life after the tour. She is focusing on her performances despite personal issues.
